What is the difference between Canvas and Studentweb?
Canvas is the learning platform; Studentweb is used for study administration and exam-related processes.
Where can I get health or counselling support?

Where can I explore research groups?

faq: Is MCI the University of Innsbruck?
No. MCI is a separate institution and the EU-HEM partner in Innsbruck.
Where will my classes take place?
MCI has several locations. Use your current timetable and programme instructions for the correct building and room.
What is the difference between myMCI and Sakai?
myMCI covers study information and administration; Sakai supports course materials and collaboration.
Can I use the University and State Library of Tyrol?
MCI documents library cooperation and activation routes; follow the current MCI instructions because access conditions differ by resource.
